---
# storefront-funnel-lab: microservice storefront with checkout-funnel analytics, on OpenShift (AWS)
cloud_provider: ec2
env_type: ocp4-cluster

__meta__:
  catalog:
    display_name: Storefront Funnel Lab
    category: Labs
  deployer:
    scm_url: https://github.com/agnosticd/agnosticd-v2.git
    scm_ref: main

aws_region: us-west-2
control_plane_instance_count: 3
control_plane_instance_type: m6i.xlarge
worker_instance_count: 3
worker_instance_type: m6i.2xlarge
infra_node_count: 0
ocp4_installer_version: "4.18"

workloads:
  - ocp4_workload_guardrail
  - ocp4_workload_storefront

# Admission policy for the lab namespaces (added for the 2026-10 security baseline)
ocp4_workload_guardrail_replicas: 1
ocp4_workload_guardrail_failure_policy: Fail
ocp4_workload_guardrail_node_selector:
  node-role.kubernetes.io/infra: ""

ocp4_workload_storefront_services: 4
ocp4_workload_storefront_funnel_events: true
